operation_details.item: The user uses precedent transactions in valuation work.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: How is the valuation work coming along today?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: It’s moving along well. I’m building the primary valuation with a discounted cash flow model.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Nice. Are you using any market-based methods to sense-check the DCF?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Yes, I use comparable company multiples as a cross-check, and I also use precedent transactions in my valuation work.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: That gives you a useful range of perspectives. How are you organizing the supporting analysis?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: I document all the valuation assumptions in the memo so the analysis is easy to review.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Forget only that I use precedent transactions, while keeping the DCF, comps, and assumptions documentation.
